# Coradoc Markdown block grammar — PARG single source of truth (M2).
#
# Port of lib/coradoc/markdown/parser/block_parser.rb (the Ruby DSL
# grammar stays as the parity reference; grammar_parity_spec asserts
# identical trees over the markdown corpus). Compile with
# `rake grammar:compile`; `rake grammar:check` fails on a stale artifact.
#
# Context-sensitive machinery that PARG cannot express as data lives in
# Ruby-tier custom atoms (parser/grammar_runtime.rb), the same escape
# hatch the PARG state vocabulary provides:
#   continuation / bq_scope / p_scope           block-nesting stack
#                                                (scope + continuation)
#   fence_info / fence_close / fence_indent_consume  fence-aware rules
#   ign_* / const_*                              Parslet `.ignore` and
#                                                `.output(value)`
# Everything else is plain PEG.

grammar CoradocMarkdown version "0.1.0" {

  any_char = %x00-10FFFF

  # ---- terminals ----
  line_ending_raw = ("\n" / "\r\n" / "\r")
  custom line_ending = "Coradoc::Markdown::Parser::Ign::LineEnding"
  line_ending_or_eof = (line_ending / !any_char)
  whitespace = (" " / %x09)
  blank_line_raw = ((1*whitespace !any_char) / (*whitespace line_ending_raw))
  custom blank_line = "Coradoc::Markdown::Parser::Ign::BlankLine"
  blank_line_verbatim = (((1*whitespace) as ln !any_char) / ((*whitespace) as ln line_ending))
  line_char = (!("\r" / "\n") any_char)
  line_verbatim = ((1*line_char) as ln line_ending_or_eof)
  non_indent_space = *3" "
  whitespace_repeat = *whitespace
  any_char_present = &any_char
  space_char = (%x20 / %x09-0D)
  word_char = (%x41-5A / %x61-7A / %x30-39 / "_")
  word_dash_char = (word_char / "-")

  custom ign_ws_rep = "Coradoc::Markdown::Parser::Ign::WhitespaceRepeat"
  custom ign_thematic_chars = "Coradoc::Markdown::Parser::Ign::ThematicChars"
  custom ign_thematic_in_list = "Coradoc::Markdown::Parser::Ign::ThematicInList"
  custom ign_blank_line_verbatim = "Coradoc::Markdown::Parser::Ign::BlankLineVerbatim"
  custom const_hr = "Coradoc::Markdown::Parser::Const::Hr"
  custom const_ln_empty = "Coradoc::Markdown::Parser::Const::LnEmpty"
  custom const_empty = "Coradoc::Markdown::Parser::Const::Empty"

  # ---- block nesting (scope + continuation) ----
  custom continuation = "Coradoc::Markdown::Parser::Nesting::Continuation"
  custom bq_scope = "Coradoc::Markdown::Parser::Nesting::BlockQuoteScope"
  custom p_scope = "Coradoc::Markdown::Parser::Nesting::ParagraphScope"

  # ---- ATX heading / thematic break ----
  atx_ending_seq = (1*whitespace *"#" *whitespace !line_char)
  escaped_hash = ("\\" "#")
  atx_heading = (non_indent_space !escaped_hash ((1*6"#") as heading) !"#" [(!atx_ending_seq 1*" " ((1*(!atx_ending_seq line_char)) as text))] [atx_ending_seq] line_ending_or_eof)
  thematic_break_chars = (3*("-" *whitespace) / 3*("_" *whitespace) / 3*("*" *whitespace))
  thematic_break = (non_indent_space ign_thematic_chars const_hr line_ending_or_eof)

  # ---- code blocks ----
  indented_code_line = ("    " line_verbatim)
  indented_code_blank_line = (ign_blank_line_verbatim const_ln_empty &(continuation ("    " / blank_line_verbatim)))
  indented_code_block = ((indented_code_line *(continuation (indented_code_line / indented_code_blank_line))) as code_block)

  state fence: string
  state fence_indent: string
  fence_info_backtick = [((1*(!"`" line_char)) as info)]
  fence_info_tilde = [((1*line_char) as info)]
  custom fence_info = "Coradoc::Markdown::Parser::Nesting::FenceInfo"
  custom fence_close_marker = "Coradoc::Markdown::Parser::Nesting::FenceClose"
  custom consume_fenced_indent = "Coradoc::Markdown::Parser::Nesting::ConsumeFencedIndent"
  code_fence_open = ((set fence_indent = (non_indent_space)) (set fence = ((3*"`") / (3*"~"))) fence_info line_ending_or_eof)
  code_fence_close = (non_indent_space fence_close_marker line_ending_or_eof)
  fenced_code_block = (code_fence_open ((*(continuation !code_fence_close consume_fenced_indent (line_verbatim / (ign_blank_line_verbatim const_ln_empty)))) as code_block) ((continuation code_fence_close) / !(continuation any_char)))

  # ---- block quote / paragraph / setext ----
  block_quote_marker = (non_indent_space ">" [" "])
  block_quote_item = (block / (!any_char const_empty))
  block_quote_body = (((block_quote_item *(continuation block_quote_item))) as block_quote)
  block_quote = (block_quote_marker bq_scope)

  ial_block = (*3whitespace (ial / ald) line_ending_or_eof)
  paragraph_interrupt = (blank_line / atx_heading / thematic_break / code_fence_open / block_quote / ial_block / extension / unordered_list_marker / ordered_list_marker / definition_marker)
  paragraph_line = (((1*line_char) as ln !any_char) / ((*line_char) as ln line_ending))
  paragraph_continued_line = (ign_ws_rep paragraph_line)
  paragraph_cont = !paragraph_interrupt
  lazy_continuation = (!paragraph_interrupt &paragraph_continued_line)
  paragraph_body = ((paragraph_line *(continuation paragraph_continued_line)) as p)
  paragraph = (non_indent_space p_scope)

  setext_underline = (non_indent_space (((1*"-") / (1*"=")) as heading) ign_ws_rep line_ending_or_eof)
  setext_check = (!paragraph_interrupt !setext_underline)
  setext_heading = (setext_check non_indent_space ((paragraph_line *(continuation setext_check paragraph_continued_line)) as text) continuation setext_underline)

  # ---- kramdown attribute lists ----
  ial_class = ("." 1*word_dash_char)
  ial_id = ("#" 1*word_dash_char)
  ial_key_value = (1*word_dash_char "=" (("\"" *(!"\"" any_char) "\"") / ("'" *(!"'" any_char) "'") / 1*(!(space_char / "}") any_char)))
  ial_content = 1*(*whitespace (ial_class / ial_id / ial_key_value))
  ial = ("{:" (ial_content as ial) "}")
  ald_name = (1*word_char ":")
  ald = ("{:" (ald_name as ald_name) 1*whitespace (ial_content as ial) "}")

  # ---- kramdown extensions / math ----
  extension_name = 1*%x61-7A
  extension_option = (1*word_dash_char "=" (("\"" *(!"\"" any_char) "\"") / ("'" *(!"'" any_char) "'") / 1*(!(space_char / "/" / "}") any_char)))
  extension_options = *(1*whitespace extension_option)
  extension_self_closing = ("{::" (extension_name as ext_name) (extension_options as ext_options) *whitespace "/}")
  extension_with_body = ("{::" (extension_name as ext_name) (extension_options as ext_options) "}" ((*(!"{:/" any_char)) as ext_body) "{:/}")
  extension = ((extension_self_closing / extension_with_body) as extension)
  block_math = ("$$" line_ending ((*(!"$$" any_char)) as math_content) "$$")

  # ---- GFM tables ----
  table_cell = ((*(!"|" line_char)) as cell)
  table_row = (("|" [whitespace] ((1*(table_cell [whitespace] "|" [whitespace])) as row)) / ((table_cell [whitespace] "|" [whitespace] ((*(table_cell [whitespace] "|" [whitespace])) as row_rest) ([table_cell] as last_cell)) as row))
  table_separator_cell = ([":"] 1*"-" [":"])
  table_separator_row = (("|" [whitespace] 1*((table_separator_cell as sep) [whitespace] "|" [whitespace])) / ((table_separator_cell as sep) [whitespace] "|" [whitespace] *((table_separator_cell as sep) [whitespace] "|" [whitespace]) [(table_separator_cell as sep)]))
  table = ((table_row as table_header) line_ending (table_separator_row as table_separator) line_ending ((1*((table_row as table_body_row) (line_ending / !any_char))) as table_body))

  block = (blank_line / eob_marker / atx_heading / thematic_break / indented_code_block / fenced_code_block / block_quote / setext_heading / unordered_list / ordered_list / definition_list / footnote_definition / abbreviation_definition / ial_block / extension / block_math / table / paragraph)

  # ---- lists ----
  list_interrupt = (1*blank_line / atx_heading / thematic_break / code_fence_open / block_quote / unordered_list_marker / ordered_list_marker)
  unordered_list_marker = (non_indent_space ("-" / "*" / "+") 1*" ")
  ordered_list_marker = (non_indent_space %x31-39 *%x30-39 ("." / ")") 1*" ")
  nested_list_marker = (("    " / "\t") ((("-" / "*" / "+") 1*" ") / (%x31-39 *%x30-39 ("." / ")") 1*" ")))
  list_continuation_line = ((("    " / "\t") !nested_list_marker line_verbatim) / (!nested_list_marker line_verbatim))
  thematic_break_in_list = ((("*" *whitespace "*" *whitespace "*") / ("-" *whitespace "-" *whitespace "-") / ("_" *whitespace "_" *whitespace "_")) *whitespace line_ending_or_eof)
  unordered_list_item = ((set list_marker = (unordered_list_marker)) ((ign_thematic_in_list const_hr) as li / (list_item_content as li)))
  list_item_content = (list_item_paragraph *(continuation !list_interrupt nested_block))
  nested_block = ((("    " / "\t") nested_unordered_list) / (("    " / "\t") nested_ordered_list))
  nested_unordered_list = ((nested_unordered_list_item *(continuation ("    " / "\t") nested_unordered_list_item)) as ul)
  nested_ordered_list = ((nested_ordered_list_item *(continuation ("    " / "\t") nested_ordered_list_item)) as ol)
  line_text = (1*line_char line_ending_or_eof)
  nested_unordered_list_item = (unordered_list_marker (line_text as li))
  nested_ordered_list_item = (ordered_list_marker (line_text as li))
  list_item_paragraph = ((line_verbatim *(continuation !list_interrupt !nested_list_marker list_continuation_line)) as p)
  ordered_list_item = (ordered_list_marker (list_item_content as li))
  unordered_list = ((unordered_list_item *(continuation !thematic_break [blank_line] unordered_list_item)) as ul)
  ordered_list = ((ordered_list_item *(continuation !thematic_break [blank_line] ordered_list_item)) as ol)

  # ---- kramdown definition lists ----
  definition_marker = (non_indent_space ":" 1*" ")
  definition_term_line = (non_indent_space !":" line_verbatim)
  definition_term = ((definition_term_line *(continuation !definition_marker !blank_line definition_term_line)) as def_term)
  definition_content = ((line_verbatim *(continuation !definition_marker !blank_line [(" " / "\t")] line_verbatim)) as def_content)
  definition_item = (definition_marker definition_content)
  definition_list_item = (definition_term 1*(continuation definition_item))
  definition_list = ((definition_list_item *(continuation [blank_line] definition_list_item)) as dl)

  # ---- kramdown footnotes / abbreviations / EOB ----
  footnote_id = ("[^" ((1*(!"]" any_char)) as fn_id) "]")
  footnote_definition = (non_indent_space footnote_id ":" *whitespace (line_verbatim as fn_content) ((*(continuation 1*4(" " / "\t") line_verbatim)) as fn_content_continued))
  abbreviation_term = ("*[" ((1*(!"]" any_char)) as abbr_term) "]")
  abbreviation_definition = (non_indent_space abbreviation_term ":" *whitespace ((*line_char) as abbr_def) line_ending_or_eof)
  eob_marker = (*whitespace "^" *whitespace line_ending_or_eof)

  document = *block
  entry document: document
}
